hostPorts.purpose: Verifies buyer-saved shipping addresses through the configured postage provider before Identity commits address snapshots.

transientRecovery.behavior: Account detail redirects carry the Identity command receipt so the account detail loader reads after the account projection catches up. If the fresh projection wait times out, the loader retries without the freshness token so the Identity account API can return committed command-side state.

Marketplace account profile redirects carry the Identity account command receipt. While the receipt is valid, transient Auth session freshness failures retry actor resolution without the fresh receipt so the route can continue to Identity-owned fresh reads. Fresh not_found, projection_freshness_timeout, and bounded gateway timeout account reads retry through Identity's command-side account state before using a temporary actor account fallback with refreshable-catching-up recovery metadata. Plain account reads can also recover from committed Account aggregate state when the account projection is absent; missing Account aggregates and unclassified failures surface normally.

source.command: Auth browser authentication that creates Identity account state

transientRecovery.behavior: Registration redirects carry the Identity account creation receipt. The marketplace shell forwards that receipt to current-actor-display so the account, user, and membership projections catch up before rendering human-readable account and user labels. If those projections are still unavailable, current-actor-display uses Identity's committed Account, User, and Membership aggregate state before falling back to actor ids.
User detail redirects carry the Identity user command receipt so the user detail loader reads after the user projection catches up.
Account security profile redirects carry the Identity user command receipt so the security loader reads after the user projection catches up.

Admin API-key create returns the plaintext secret only as transient action data, then detail navigation reads after the API-key projection catches up. The detail route can re-fetch persisted API-key metadata, but never re-fetches the plaintext secret.

API key detail redirects carry the Identity API-key command receipt so the detail loader reads after the API-key projection catches up. If the fresh projection wait times out, the loader retries without the freshness token so the Identity API-key API can return committed command-side state.

Admin API-key create keeps the operator on the API-key list to show the plaintext secret once as transient action data, while the persisted API-key list metadata catches up through the API-key projection.
Account security API-key redirects carry the Identity API-key command receipt so the security loader reads after the API-key projection catches up.

Invitation create remains covered for invitation list freshness because the source list route owns the create form and can refresh invitation list data through the invitation projection freshness route.

Invitation create redirects carry the Identity invitation command receipt to the new detail route so the detail loader reads after the invitation projection catches up. If the fresh projection wait times out, the loader retries without the freshness token so the Identity invitation API can return committed command-side state.

Invitation detail redirects carry the Identity invitation command receipt so the detail loader reads after the invitation projection catches up. If the fresh projection wait times out, the loader retries without the freshness token so the Identity invitation API can return committed command-side state.
Account team invitation redirects carry the Identity invitation command receipt so the team loader reads after the invitation projection catches up.
Membership detail redirects carry the Identity membership command receipt so the detail loader reads after the membership projection catches up.
Account team membership redirects carry the Identity membership command receipt so the team loader reads after the membership projection catches up.
Shipping-address redirects carry the Identity shipping-address command receipt so the address-book loader reads after the shipping-address projection catches up.
Account profile, lifecycle, and context-anchored invitation forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload account or invitation pages through Identity projection freshness routes.

User profile, contact-method, auth-method, lifecycle, and context-anchored API-key forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload user, security, or API-key pages through Identity projection freshness routes.

visibleDestination.description: The admin API-key list create action returns the newly generated plaintext secret as same-page action data exactly once, with API-key id and prefix, instead of redirecting or waiting for a projected list read.

proof.authoritativeResponse: bounded-contexts/identity/features/api-keys/api/route.ts creates and hashes the secret in one request, stores only the hash, and returns the plaintext only in the create response; bounded-contexts/identity/routes/admin/api-keys.tsx passes that response through as transient action data.

visibleDestination.description: The admin API-key detail rotate action returns the replacement plaintext secret as same-page action data exactly once, with API-key id and prefix, instead of redirecting or re-fetching the secret.

proof.authoritativeResponse: bounded-contexts/identity/features/api-keys/api/route.ts rotates and hashes the secret in one request, stores only the hash, and returns the plaintext only in the rotate response; bounded-contexts/identity/routes/admin/api-keys-detail.tsx passes that response through as transient action data.

transientRecovery.behavior: API-key revoke forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload detail pages through the API-key projection freshness route.

visibleDestination.description: Marketplace account security create and rotate API-key actions return the plaintext secret as same-page action data exactly once, with API-key id and prefix, instead of redirecting or re-fetching the secret.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The Identity API-key create and rotate API routes generate the plaintext once, store only the hash, and return the plaintext only in the mutation response; the marketplace account-security route passes that response through as transient action data.

transientRecovery.behavior: Account security API-key revoke forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload the security page through the API-key projection freshness route.
Invitation create forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload invitation list pages through the invitation projection freshness route.
Invitation resend, cancel, and decline forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload detail pages through the invitation projection freshness route.
Account team invitation forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload team invitations through the invitation projection freshness route.
Membership role and lifecycle forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload detail pages through the membership projection freshness route.
Account team membership forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload team memberships through the membership projection freshness route.
Shipping address forms redirect with Identity command receipts and reload address-book pages through the shipping-address projection freshness route.

visibleDestination.description: Terms of Service acceptance writes re-resolve and return the committed acceptance status (policy key, active required version, accepted version, accepted timestamp) directly from the read model immediately after recording, so the caller sees the committed fact and can proceed past the acceptance gate without waiting on projection catch-up.

proof.authoritativeResponse: termsOfServiceConsentRoutes POST /accept records RecordConsent then returns resolveTermsAcceptanceStatus recomputed against the same read model.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/features/consents/api/terms-route.test.ts proves accept returns the server-resolved active version, ignores a client-supplied version, and is idempotent when already current.

visibleDestination.description: User Preferences API writes return the authenticated User id, aggregate version, update status, and resolved preferences directly from the command result, so shell callers can render the committed setting without waiting on the preferences projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: userPreferencesRoutes returns services.commandHandler result.version plus userPreferencesFor(actor.userId, result.state) after SetUserPreferences.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/features/preferences/api/route.test.ts proves preference updates return committed version/status/preferences and reject invalid or cross-user writes.

visibleDestination.description: Internal Auth-facing Identity mutations return the committed User, Account, Membership, Invitation, Consent, or credential command snapshots in the same API response used by Auth registration, passkey, social-login, invitation, and guest-checkout flows; Auth can continue from those ids and versions without waiting on Identity projections.

proof.authoritativeResponse: buildIdentityApi now returns a scoped snapshots array from the command handler results for internal Auth mutations, and createIdentityAuthRequestClient forwards those response snapshots instead of swallowing credential/link results.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/tests/api-mutation-snapshots.test.ts proves internal Auth mutation routes return committed aggregate snapshots with id, version, and status.

visibleDestination.description: Account management API writes return the command-owned account id, aggregate version, lifecycle status, and badge list when badges change, so admin and account flows have the committed Account snapshot before any projected list or detail reload catches up.

proof.authoritativeResponse: accountRoutes builds every mutation response from services.accounts.commandHandler results and includes result.version plus result.state.status and badges where applicable.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/tests/api-mutation-snapshots.test.ts proves Account create, update, lifecycle, and badge writes return command result snapshots.

visibleDestination.description: API-key creation, rotation, resolution, and revocation return command-local key ids, versions, statuses, secret prefixes, one-time secrets, or lookup results from the same Identity write request without depending on an API-key read-model refresh.

proof.authoritativeResponse: API-key handlers return commandHandler result.version/result.state.status and the scoped secret or lookup fields produced or verified in the same request; resolve also returns the RecordApiKeyUse command version/status.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/tests/api-mutation-snapshots.test.ts proves API-key create, rotate, resolve, and revoke writes return committed secret, lookup, and status receipts.

visibleDestination.description: Invitation API writes return the Invitation id, aggregate version, and lifecycle status from the command result, so team-management callers can show pending, cancelled, declined, or resent state without trusting a lagging invitation projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: invitationRoutes returns the command-owned id/version/status immediately after create, resend, cancel, or decline.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/tests/api-mutation-snapshots.test.ts proves Invitation create, resend, cancel, and decline write responses reflect command result versions and statuses.

visibleDestination.description: Membership grant, role-change, revoke, and reinstate responses return the Membership id, aggregate version, and status from the command result, avoiding a projection-backed membership detail read for the committed write result.

proof.authoritativeResponse: membershipRoutes returns services.memberships.commandHandler result.version and result.state.status for each mutating route.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/tests/api-mutation-snapshots.test.ts proves Membership grant, role, revoke, and reinstate responses return command snapshots.

visibleDestination.description: Shipping Address API writes return the affected Shipping Address id, aggregate version, and operation status directly from the command response; marketplace account address-book routes can use that receipt while same-route refresh handles non-projection account continuity.

proof.authoritativeResponse: shippingAddressRoutes returns command result versions and scoped operation statuses for add, update, set default, and archive without reading the Shipping Address projection in the write response.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/tests/api-mutation-snapshots.test.ts proves Shipping Address writes return id/version/status receipts.

visibleDestination.description: User profile, contact-method, authentication-method, suspend, and reactivate API writes return the User id, aggregate version, and status from the command result, allowing admin or account security flows to render the committed User result without waiting on the user projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: userRoutes returns services.users.commandHandler result.version and result.state.status after every User mutation.
tests: bounded-contexts/identity/tests/api-mutation-snapshots.test.ts proves User create, update, contact-method, auth-method, suspend, and reactivate responses return command snapshots.
